messages.subject: genetic map
parts:
Hi, Karl

I am working on my genetic map, after ordering markers in every chromosome, I plotted my map (attached) and found that some markers in certain chromosomes were separated by a gap of more than 100cM.
So I used droponemarker function to identify these trouble markers on the chromosomes. However, after I removed these problematic markers, the overall mapping length increased several folds. My question is under what circumstances would removing these markers increase rather than decrease the overall mapping length? Any way to troubleshoot this and enhance the final quality of the map? Thank you very much for your help.

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] genetic map
parts:
You've got pairs of adjacent markers that are basically not  linked to each other. I'd look at the pairwiise recombination fractions with plot.rf. 

karl
